prompt:
Generate one standalone 16:9 horizontal Chinese article illustration.

Visual DNA:
Pure white background. Minimalist black hand-drawn line art. Slightly wobbly pen lines. Lots of empty white space. Sparse red/orange/blue handwritten Chinese annotations. Clean absurd product-sketch feeling. No gradients, no shadows, no paper texture, no complex background, no commercial vector style, no PPT infographic look, no cute mascot poster, no children's illustration, no realistic UI.

Recurring IP character required:
小黑, a small solid-black cat with white dot eyes, simple pointed ears, a short tail, tiny thin legs, blank serious expression, slightly uneven hand-drawn body shape. 小黑 must perform the core conceptual action, not decorate the scene. Make 小黑 serious, deadpan, and slightly bizarre, not cute or kawaii.

Theme:
AI Agent learns the legacy baggage of a codebase instead of the real design system

Structure type:
概念隐喻 / Conceptual metaphor

Core idea:
小黑 walks into a huge dusty warehouse full of rusty, broken, deprecated parts and seriously picks one up to copy. A few brand-new shiny parts sit untouched on a clean shelf to the side. The Agent imitates whatever the codebase already shows the most of, even if it is junk.

Composition:
小黑 stands in the center-left, holding up a rusty crooked legacy component like a treasure. Behind 小黑 is a tall messy warehouse shelf stacked with rusty boxes labeled in Chinese handwriting. On the far right, a small clean shelf with two shiny tidy new components sits ignored, with a dust cloud or a tiny spider web on it. A handwritten arrow points from the rusty stack to 小黑 saying that's the dominant signal.

Suggested elements:
rusty legacy components on a tall warehouse shelf / a dusty box labeled 旧组件 / a deprecated hook tag dangling from 小黑's paw / a small ignored shelf of two clean new parts / a thin handwritten arrow with the word 抄这个

Chinese handwritten labels:
旧组件仓库 / 抄这个 / 信号最强 / 被废弃 hook / 没人用·跳过

Color use:
Black for main line art and 小黑. Matte warm gold (#A07848) for the main arrow and key emphasis. Red only for the rusty/deprecated warning marks. Blue only for the ignored clean shelf side note. Do not use orange; use the warm gold tone instead.

Constraints:
One image explains only one core structure. Keep the main subject around 40%-60% of the canvas. Preserve at least 35% blank white space. Use at most 5-8 short handwritten Chinese labels. Do not write a title in the top-left corner. Do not write the structure type on the image. Do not make it a formal diagram, course slide, or dense explainer. Do not copy prior examples or reuse known case compositions; invent a fresh visual metaphor. It should be clear but not instructional, interesting but not childish, strange but clean.

Theme:
Natural language rules cannot beat existing code as a prompt for the Agent

Structure type:
前后对比 / pulling-force metaphor

Core idea:
小黑 stands in the middle holding a huge, comically thick rule book labeled 规则文档 / Rules.md in one paw. But its body is visibly leaning, tilted, dragged sideways toward a giant magnetic pile of stacked code files. The rule book has no gravity, the code does. The codebase is the real prompt.

Composition:
小黑 in the center, body tilted strongly to the right, paws gripping a thick wobbly book labeled 规则文档 on the left. On the right, a tall magnetic stack of code file rectangles (with dot-dot-dot text inside) emits faint curved magnet lines that wrap around 小黑's body. A few page corners of the rule book are flying away in the magnetic wind, with tiny crossed-out icons.

Suggested elements:
thick rule book with a bookmark / horseshoe-shaped magnet behind the code stack / curved magnetic field lines / code files drawn as rectangles with tiny zigzag content / fluttering torn rule pages

Chinese handwritten labels:
规则文档 / 没人看 / 代码堆 / 真·Prompt / 磁吸

Color use:
Black for main line art and 小黑. Matte warm gold (#A07848) for the magnetic field lines and the 真·Prompt label arrow. Red only for the crossed-out flying rule page. Blue only for the secondary rule-book label. Do not use orange; use the warm gold tone instead.

Theme:
A reference examples directory works as a north star that guides the Agent out of the foggy legacy codebase

Structure type:
地图路线 / Map-and-path metaphor

Core idea:
小黑 walks through a foggy night map of tangled streets and dead-end alleys (the legacy codebase). One single glowing star labeled examples/ hangs in the sky above. 小黑 only has to look up and follow the star to reach the correct path. The star is the actual reference implementation, brighter and more trustworthy than any street sign.

Composition:
小黑 stands center-bottom on a small dotted path, looking up. The lower half of the canvas is filled with low fog wisps and a few sketchy dead-end forks with confusing handwritten signs in Chinese. The upper-right corner has one bold five-point star with small radiating spikes, labeled examples/. A dashed handwritten line connects the star down to 小黑's path. Around the star there is plenty of empty white sky.

Suggested elements:
foggy dead-end alley signs / tangled crossing street lines / a single bold north star / dashed guiding line / small backpack on 小黑

Chinese handwritten labels:
examples/ / 北极星 / 照着抄 / 别乱拐 / 旧路弃用

Color use:
Black for main line art and 小黑. Matte warm gold (#A07848) for the north star and the guiding dashed line. Red only for the 弃用 deadend sign. Blue only for a secondary fog or breath label. Do not use orange; use the warm gold tone instead.

Theme:
Agent amplifies the broken-window effect of a messy codebase to an extreme degree

Structure type:
概念隐喻 / Broken-window amplification

Core idea:
A tidy house has only one cracked window on the left. 小黑 picks up that broken window like a stencil or a stamp, and starts copying it across every other panel of the wall on the right. The whole house ends up with rows of identical cracked windows. One small mess becomes a compounded mess at machine speed.

Composition:
Left third: a small clean tidy house with one cracked window panel highlighted. Center: 小黑 stands on a tiny ladder, lifting that exact broken window like a wooden stencil, with a serious deadpan face. Right two thirds: an extended wall of the house growing horizontally, where 小黑 has already stamped 3-5 identical cracked window panels in a row. Tiny stamping motion lines around 小黑's paw.

Suggested elements:
one original cracked window outlined as a stencil / 小黑 holding the stencil with both paws / stamped repeating broken windows on the wall / tiny stamping action lines / a small dust puff under the ladder

Chinese handwritten labels:
1 处脏代码 / 复制 100 份 / 模板 / 机器复利 / 破窗扩散

Color use:
Black for main line art and 小黑. Matte warm gold (#A07848) for the stencil outline and the 模板 emphasis. Red only for the cracks themselves to make the damage visible. Blue only for a quiet side annotation. Do not use orange; use the warm gold tone instead.
